description: This source file contains unit tests for the GatewayChannelActor component in a Swift project, specifically testing connection handling and failure scenarios using mock WebSocket sessions.

classes.name: GatewayChannelConnectTests

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session with predefined responses for testing connection success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: `concurrent connect is single flight on success`
methods.description: Tests that concurrent connection attempts result in only one actual connection when the first succeeds.

methods.name: `concurrent connect shares failure`
methods.description: Tests that concurrent connection attempts share failure results, ensuring only one failure is reported.
